svg.title: Long-Term Care Medicaid Home Equity Caps
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-medicaid-home-equity-caps; chapter number: 4; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Long-Term Care Medicaid Home Equity Caps; subtitle: Current limits versus the flat cap starting January 1, 2028; total range: $752,000 to $1.13 million; caption: Home equity must sit under the limit to qualify for long-term care Medicaid unless a spouse or a minor or disabled child lives there.; assumptions note: The 2028 cap is reported at $1 million with no inflation increases; DC's limit drops under it. Each bucket is a single reported figure, so low and high are equal.; note: Caps reported by Marc Cormier.; buckets: label: Maryland today; low: 752000; high: 752000; notes: $752,000 current limit.; label: Virginia today; low: 752000; high: 752000; notes: $752,000 current limit; a broader-estate recovery state.; label: DC today; low: 1130000; high: 1130000; notes: $1.13 million current limit, which falls under the 2028 cap.; label: All three from January 1, 2028; low: 1000000; high: 1000000; notes: $1 million with no inflation increases.
